title: CreditMind
summary: CreditMind is a credit-scoring project whose m1_synthetic_data.py script generates synthetic client records as a fallback data-augmentation step when a primary generative model (tab-ddpm) is unavailable. It directly instantiates and fits the standalone ctgan CTGAN model, then falls back to a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata, and finally runs SDMetrics's QualityReport to score the synthetic data against the real data.
